```{r}
# this is to nicely format large numbers
# should choose appropriate number of decimal places etc
y_formatting_js <- "
        function(value) {
          if (value >= 1000000000) {
            return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
                maximumSignificantDigits: 3
            }).format(value / 1000000000) + 'B';
          }
          if (value >= 1000000) {
            return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
                maximumSignificantDigits: 3
            }).format(value / 1000000) + 'M';
          }
          if (value >= 1000) {
            return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
                maximumSignificantDigits: 3
            }).format(value / 1000) + 'K';
          }
          return value;
        }
      "
```

```{r}
library(omopgenerics)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(OmopSketch)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(echarts4r)
library(visOmopResults)
library(gt)
library(stringr)

snapshot <- importSummarisedResult(here("data_network", "data", "snapshot.csv"))

clinical_records <- read_csv(here("data_network", "data", "clinical_records.csv"))

  
plotTableTrend <- function(workingData, workingTable){
workingData |> 
  mutate(date = stringr::str_remove(time_interval, " to.*")) |> 
   mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |> 
  mutate(omop_table = stringr::str_replace_all(omop_table, "_", " ")) |> 
  filter(in_observation == "overall",
         time_interval != "overall",
         variable_name == "Number of records",
         is.na(name_observation_period)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(count)) |>  
  filter(omop_table == workingTable) |> 
  select(cdm_name, count, date) |> 
  filter(!is.na(count)) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = cdm_name,
                     values_from = count) |> 
  arrange(date) |> 
  e_charts(date) |> 
  e_bar(`Barts Health`, stack = "grp") |>
  e_bar(`DataLoch Lothian`, stack = "grp") |>
  e_bar(`CPRD Aurum`, stack = "grp") |>
  e_bar(`Lancashire Teaching Hospital`, stack = "grp")  |>
  e_bar(`Great Ormond Street Hospital`, stack = "grp")  |>
  e_bar(`Leeds Teaching Hospitals`, stack = "grp")  |>
  e_bar(`University College London Hospitals`, stack = "grp") |>
  e_datazoom() |>
  e_tooltip() |>
  e_y_axis(
    axisLabel = list(
      formatter = htmlwidgets::JS(y_formatting_js)
    )
  ) 
}
```

# Snapshot

```{r}
snap <- snapshot |> 
  filter(variable_name %in% c("cdm", "general")) |> 
  filter_out(estimate_name %in% c("holder_name", 
                                  "source_name",
                                  "description",
                                  "documentation_reference", 
                                  "snapshot_date"))

tableOmopSnapshot(snap,
                  groupColumn = c("estimate_name"),
                  hide = c("variable_level", "variable_name")) |> 
  gt::tab_caption("")
```

# Clinical records

## Drug exposure

```{r}
plotTableTrend(clinical_records, "drug exposure")
```
